title: Evaluation Is Unchanged by an Unused Coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $F$ assign a real coefficient to each subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $X_j,Y_j:\Omega\to\bbr$ be two families of real-valued functions. If $F(S)=0$ for every subset $S$ containing a fixed coordinate $i$, and $X_j=Y_j$ for every $j\ne i$, then the multilinear evaluations of $F$ on the two families are equal as functions on $\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real coefficient family on subsets of the $n$-coordinate set
$i$ is a coordinate in that set
replaced: Let $F$ be real multilinear coefficients on $n$ inputs and let $i\in[n]$ satisfy $F(S)=0$ for every $S$ containing $i$. If functions $X_j,Y_j:\Omega\to\bbr$ agree for every $j\ne i$, then $\sum_S F(S)\prod_{j\in S}X_j=\sum_S F(S)\prod_{j\in S}Y_j$ as functions on $\Omega$.
